translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Dos Kopotayan ni Juan no Tohodboutismu
Na iddon timpu, si Herodes no gubernador to Galilea,
norinog din iddos moka-atag taddot pinuungan ni Disas.
Woy id ikohiyan din kos mgo sudsuhuwon din to, “Ini si Disas, sikandin en si Juan no Tohodboutismu no novadnow pomon diyot kopotayan. Ini en kos unayan nod pokopuung sikandin to mgo mokososoobbu.”

Id ikahi idda ni Herodes, su iddot id lihad, id pa-ammot din si Juan, id povaku woy id poprisu. Id puungan din idda pomon to kodsugga ni Juan kandin, su id ahaw rin si Herodias no sawa taddot ari rin no si Felipe.
Oyya su inaayun od ikohiyan ni Juan si Herodes to, “Supak diyot mgo Suhu ni Moises no od ahawon du kos sawa to suwod du.”
Pomon tadda, id kopi-i ni Herodes nod po-imotayan din si Juan, piru novaakkan sikandin to mo-uraan minuvu, oyyos id pomakoy ran no propeta en si Juan.

Na riyot kodsampot ni Herodes to allow't kodtobbow rin, id pista sikandin, woy id sayow iddos mongovay no anak ni Herodias ki Felipe riyot isowwan to langun nid inggat din. Oray'n notoosan si Herodes taddot kodsayow to mongovay.
De-en id totandu sikandin, kahi rin to, “Od pongulivot a no id boggoy ku en kikow kos ahad ondan nod buyuwon du.”
Na pomon to id sutsutan to inoy rin iddos mongovay, mid ikahi sikandin to, “Boggoy ru koddi no nokota-aw riyot bondihadu iddos uu ni Juan no Tohodboutismu!”
To norinog idda ni Herodes, nokodsondit sikandin. Piru pomon to id pongulivot don sikandin woy'd ko-ilow taddot id pon-inggat din, mid suhu sikandin no id boggoy iddos id buyu taddot mongovay.
De-en id po-undiyon din to prisuwan iddos sokkad taddot mgo sundau rin amoy'd tompoddan to liyog si Juan.
Na, id piyod din iddos uu ni Juan no nokota-aw ron diyot bondihadu, woy id boggoy rin idda riyot mongovay. Id piyod mandad idda taddot mongovay riyon to inoy rin.

To norinog taddot mgo tinodduwan ni Juan iddon notomanan, id undiyon dan to prisuwan, woy id angoy ran iddos lawa ni Juan amoy id lobbong. Nopongnga idda, id undiyon dan to ki Disas amoy id ponudtuu ran kandin iddos moka-atag tadda.
Dos Kodpoka-an ni Disas to Limmon Maan (5,000) no Minuvu

Na, to norinog onni Disas iddon notomanan, id tanan dan dutun woy mid sakoy to bollangay po-undiyot noka-awoy-awoy'n lugaa no siksikandan da. Piru to nokosaddoo iddos mo-uraan minuvu no id pomon diyot nokod-osso-osson bonuwa, mid lupug dan kandin nid pongulibpit diyot lanow.
To koddunggu onni Disas woy to kodponog din, nokita rin iddos mo-uraan minuvu no nolivuung. No-eruwan sikandin woy id bowiyan din iddos od pongkovohokan.

To od komapun don, id porani ki Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan woy mid ikahi to, “Noka-awoy-awoy inin lugaa, woy asow ron od saop kos allow. Iyon ayu moppiya no od po-undiyonnon du to mgo bariyu inis mo-uraan minuvu amoy'd pokovolli ran to koka-an.”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Konnad ko-ilangan nod undiyon sikandan. Sikiyu kos od poka-an kandan.”
Kahi ran to, “Eh, toonaw ra man limmon molison no paan woy oruwon ngaap inis ka-ay't keta.”
Kahin Disas to, “Piyodda row idda rinit koddi.”

Na, id osengan din iddos mgo minuvu no od unsad diyot sobbotton. Nopongnga idda, id angoy rin iddos limmon molison no paan woy oruwon ngaap. Mid langngag sikandin diyot datas to langit woy id posolamat diyon to Monama. Nopongnga, id pontoppiktoppik din idda woy id boggoy rin diyot mgo tinodduwan din amoy id sondad diyot mgo minuvu.
Na, nokoka-an dan langun woy nongovuung. Nopongnga, id temmos dan iddos nongosama woy nokoponnu pa en idda to sopuu-oruwon bukag.
Dos mgo minuvu nid ka-an, mgo limmon maan (5,000) no mama, waa pa apii to kod-iyap iddos mgo ba-ay woy mgo anak.
Dos Kod-ipanow ni Disas diyon to Ampow't Oweg
Nopongnga idda, id posakoy ni Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din diyot bollangay, woy id po-unna rin sikandan diyot dipaa to lanow laggun tid popo-uli rin pa iddos mgo minuvu.
To id ipanow ron iddos mgo minuvu, mid tikoddog sikandin po-undiyot buvungan amoy'd dasaa. To od kosagkup don, diyon poron si Disas no siksikandin da.
Na idda mandad so mgo tinodduwan din no id pomollangay, diyon don sikandan to moriyu pomon diyot ibpit to lanow. Nosinuggung dan kos kaamag, de-en nosuhat to doorakkoon mgo baud iddos bollangay.
To od ka-allow-allow ron, id undiyonnan sikandan ni Disas no id ipanow riyon to ampow't oweg.
To nokita sikandin taddot mgo tinodduwan, oraroy ran no novaakkan woy id pomehes dan to mattag allak, kahi ran to, “Eh, busow!”
Piru idda ron en, mid ikahi si Disas kandan to, “Yo kow'd kovaakki, su siyak ini!”
Na kahin Pedro kandin to, “Longaggon, otik mooggot en no sikkow ika, po-unduwonna a to kikow nod ipanow ka-ay to ampow't oweg.”
Mid ikahi si Disas to, “Na undini ka.” De-en id ponog si Pedro taddot bollangay, woy id ipanow sikandin diyon to ampow't oweg po-undiyot ki Disas.

Piru to noheddam din iddos monokkaan kaamag woy to nokita rin iddos doorakkoon baud, novaakkan sikandin woy enot-enot don od koonnod. Na, id pomehes sikandin no mid ungketen to, “Longaggon, tovangi a!”
Idda ron en, id so-ut sikandin tid apput ni Disas woy id somaddan. Kahi rin to, “Oray mohon disok kos kopomakoy ru! Mambot id duworuwa ka?”
Na mid sakoy sikandan diyot bollangay, woy idda ron en, id soro iddos kaamag.
Dos id sakoy taddot bollangay, mid simba kandin woy kahi ran to, “Mooggot ka en no Anak to Monama.”
Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos od Pongkovohokan diyot Genesaret
Na, to nokorunggu ran diyot dipaa to lanow, noko-inguma ran diyot lugaa to Genesaret.
To nokilaa si Disas to mgo minuvu taddon lugaa, id posaddoo ran diyot langun no lugaa no nokolingkus dutun no riyon sikandin. De-en id piyod to mgo minuvu riyot kandin iddos langun nod kovohokan.
Id po-eru-eru ran ki Disas no od posomaddon iddos od pongkovohokan, ahad ubpu robbo taddot umpak din. Na iddos langun no nokosomad kandin, no-uliyan en.

footnotes.text: Ini si Herodes, id ngoranan mandad ki Antipas. Anak sikandin ni Harin Herodes no id hari timpu to kodtobbow ni Disas.
